guidance.statement: NIM to remain range-bound reflecting external benchmark repricing on loans and deposit repricing dynamics
guidance.quote: NIM should be range-bound from here on

guidance.statement: Cost growth to moderate from current 13.2% pace; Labour Code will add recurring costs but pace to slow
guidance.quote: cost to go up at the pace at which they had gone up maybe till a couple quarters ago

guidance.statement: Credit card book to improve and grow from Q4 onwards after Q3 festive-driven one-off decline
guidance.quote: the book should grow from here on

guidance.statement: Personal loans and credit cards to pick up from currently muted levels as loan growth accelerates
guidance.quote: definitely believe it should pick up from these levels

guidance.statement: Will work to renew/repay ₹20-25,000 crore agriculture portfolio to conform with PSL guidelines; minimize provisions
guidance.quote: endeavour would be to minimise the PSL and provisioning impact

guidance.statement: Sandeep Bakhshi's two-year extension from October 2026 to October 2028; nearly three years forward
guidance.quote: It is starting from October of '26 and goes on till October '28

guidance.statement: 17.34% total CAR very adequate to support growth; no near-term capital raise anticipated

delivered.statement: NII grew 7.7% YoY to ₹21,932 crore; NIM held stable at 4.30%
Grew 6.3% YoY to ₹6,572 crore; 78% from retail, rural, business banking customers
Grew 6.0% YoY to ₹17,513 crore in Q3; profit before tax ₹14,957 crore
₹11,318 crore in Q3; adjusted for PSL provision would increase 4.1% YoY to ₹12,280 crore
Domestic loans 11.5% YoY; retail 7.2%, business banking 22.8%, corporate 5.6%
Net NPA ratio 0.37% vs 0.39% prior quarter; provisioning coverage 75.4%
Average deposits 8.7% YoY; CASA deposits 8.9% YoY; total period-end 9.2% YoY
CET-1 16.46%, total CAR 17.34% including 9M profits; net worth ₹3.23 lakh crore

themes: 360-degree customer-centric approach with risk-calibrated profitable growth and PBT maximization focus
Asset quality strengthened; net NPA 0.37% with 75.4% coverage on non-performing loans
NIM stability at 4.30% sustained despite 125 bps rate cuts and competitive pressure
Digital innovation and customer security enhancements: SmartLock, domain change, 1600-series outbound calls
Diversified growth across retail (7.2%), business banking (22.8%), corporate (5.6%) segments
Strong capital position (17.34% CAR) enabling sustainable franchise expansion and shareholder returns
risks: RBI-mandated ₹1,283 cr PSL provision on ₹20-25,000 cr agriculture portfolio exposes 13-year compliance gap; resolution timeline unclear
NIM compression risk from 125 bps rate cuts; 56% of loans on external benchmarks repricing downward in FY27
Weak unsecured lending (credit cards -3.5% YoY, personal loans 2.4%) constrains profit leverage vs 11.5% loan growth
Operating expense inflation (13.2% YoY) from labour codes and compliance limiting profit growth and ROA expansion

analyst_pushback.response: Bank will work to renew portfolio in conformity; provisions continue until loans repaid or renewed per PSL
analyst_pushback.quote: will continue until the loans are repaid or renewed in conformity with PSL guidelines

analyst_pushback.issue: CEO two-year extension vs traditional three-year term
analyst_pushback.response: Board with MD decided two years; nearly three years from today; too early to speculate further on succession
analyst_pushback.quote: Board in consultation with the MD decided that two-year term is what it is at

analyst_pushback.issue: Low profit growth amid bank size constraints
analyst_pushback.response: Rate cuts and repricing impacting growth; strategy working well but bank always aims to do much better
analyst_pushback.quote: Of course, we can do much better. I hope we do much better

analyst_pushback.issue: Credit card weakness persists despite overall growth
analyst_pushback.response: Decline was one-off from Q2 festive spends being repaid in Q3; expects gradual improvement from Q4
analyst_pushback.quote: book decline is more one-off and we should see it gradually improve from here on

tone_evidence: Confident on capital strength, asset quality improvements; defensive explaining PSL compliance, profit growth, CEO succession signals
